AND (
( d.project_id IN
#{projectId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ast_device_project_relationship r WHERE r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.device_sn = d.sn AND r.project_id IN
#{projectId}
AND r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND r.deleted = b'0' ) ) OR
CAST(d.contract_no AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{contractNo} AS BINARY) OR
OR 1 = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(d.contract_no AS BINARY) FROM ast_device d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND d.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND d.contract_no <> '' AND NOT COALESCE((), FALSE) AND d.id = #{query.deviceId}

SELECT d.id, d.sn, d.name, d.status
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}

SELECT d.id AS device_id, d.sn, d.name, d.status, d.product_code, d.product_model, d.product_name, d.shipment_time, d.package_no, d.contract_no, d.shipment_record_id, d.project_id, d.customer_id, d.warranty_start_date, d.warranty_end_date, d.warranty_status, d.conp_version, d.conp_type, d.conp_series, d.conp_mark, d.sync_status, d.location_snapshot, d.location_resolution_status
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
